new_value: FIXED on beads-worker-4: _reannounce_capabilities_to_new_root now announces only to the newest drained DODAGID (changes[-1]) instead of every queued transition; earlier flap entries are superseded history and no longer receive signed capability statements. Guard reordered to 'not changes or capabilities == 0' (fixes the empty-queue IndexError the reorder initially exposed); drain still precedes the capabilities==0 early-return so silent nodes never leak ledger entries. Regression test test_root_flap_announces_only_to_current_root (A->B->A flap queues 2 transitions, exactly 1 POST to A). Verification: 7/7 reannounce tests + 140 node tests pass; ruff check/format clean; mypy clean. 3x codereview (kimi): correctness PASS, security PASS, robustness PASS with one P4 doc nit (docstring still said 'each new root') — corrected inline in this same diff since it was introduced by this fix.
